summary: The five prior-round findings appear addressed. Two plan gaps remain.

recommendations.location: Task 9: SDK notification handling, result serialization and BridgeConfig
recommendations.issue: [P2] The adapter steps do not state the approved 8 MiB cumulative decoded-event cap, 256 KiB complete serialized MCP-result cap, or 10–1800 second timeout range. Generic overflow and timeout tests could pass while those specific bounds are violated.
recommendations.suggestion: Specify and test each exact boundary. Stop consuming notifications immediately when the decoded-event cap is crossed, and apply the result cap to success, error and replay responses.

recommendations.issue: [P2] An active checkbox still offers a PR-per-round review route, conflicting with the amendment’s required local review followed by one authoritative PR round.
recommendations.suggestion: Replace that choice with the mandated local-first sequence before publication.
